name: Moniker
summary: Own your name online: one profile and handle every app reads.
built: Profiles and handles live on one shared ledger any app can read.
Handles are sold person to person; the payment and the transfer land together.
Only the holder's key can change what a profile says.

name: Fanfare
summary: Show tickets fans own and can resell at any price.
built: Each ticket is a record its holder controls; buying it pays the seller in the same step.
Door staff check a pass signed by the holder's wallet.
An artist can launch a coin of their own for fans to hold.

name: Stoa
summary: Forums no one can censor. Posts belong to their authors.
built: Every community gets a ledger of its own, and anyone can start one.
Moderators can only label posts; each reader chooses whose labels to follow.
Names and avatars come from Moniker.

name: Rave
summary: Reviews of places that no company owns. You choose whose ratings count.
built: Runs on Stoa's rules unchanged: places, reviews and replies are all posts.
Ranking and filtering happen in the reader's page, and it says why.
Its public hosts take writes with no fee.

name: Wheatpaste
summary: One shared billboard. Post over anyone; the price is the only rule.
built: Space on the board is owned, cut up, and resold like land.
An ad pays each square's owner for every block it runs, up front.
Covering an ad pays back the poster it covers.
